name: ConcentrateShipmentScheduler
tagline: Port stock, vessel nominations, laycans, moisture/TML gates and concentrate invoicing in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete concentrate marketing and shipping app for Canvas and Model-driven apps: 60-day port-shed stock projection against the shipping programme, vessel nominations and laycans per buyer with berth-clash and ETA risk flags, moisture vs TML (IMSBC Code) and loading-tolerance gates, and provisional / final invoices from assays and moisture.
features: Status flow Planned → Nominated → Laycan confirmed → Loading → Sailed → Provisionally invoiced → Final settled with rule-checked transitions
Port stock projection with shed capacity and shortfall detection
Laycan timeline by berth with ETA markers, clash and risk outlines
Moisture ≥ TML blocks loading; safety-margin warning
Provisional and final invoice calculation (dmt, payable metal, TC/RC, provisional %, balance)
Bulk status moves with skip reasons, undo, CSV export
Phone layout with bottom view bar
pack: Niray Mining & Natural Resources PCF Pack
